adjudication.rationale: In `addGuests.handler.ts`, new guests are filtered with a case-sensitive comparison: `!booking.attendees.some((attendee) => guest === attendee.email)` and blacklist checking uses `blacklistedGuestEmails.includes(guest)` while the blacklist is lowercased but `guest` is not. Since neither the schema (`z.string().email()`) nor UI normalizes casing, emails differing only by case can bypass both duplicate detection and blacklist checks, leading to duplicate attendee records / unintended additions.
